site.name: VICTORIA / BRITISH COLUMBIA
site.desc: Public Health Agency of Canada confirmed one positive hantavirus case among four Canadian Hondius returnees (AP News, 15 May): Yukon resident in their 70s hospitalized in Victoria with fever and headache, mild symptoms. Confirmatory PCR sent to National Microbiology Lab Winnipeg; partner tested negative. Dr. Bonnie Henry reassured no increased risk to general public.

site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: WHO DON601 (13 May) confirms 11 total cases: 8 laboratory-confirmed Andes virus, 2 probable, 1 inconclusive pending further testing; 3 deaths. No new cases or deaths since previous update; crew remains asymptomatic. Vessel evacuated at Granadilla de Abona; en route Rotterdam with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse for full disinfection.
